title: Brik Tunisian Savory Pastry
description: A simple Tunisian recipe for Brik pastry, filled with wholesome ingredients and served with a side of tangy sauce. Brik pastry is a traditional Tunisian dish made with flaky laminations and crispy exterior.

ingredients.name: Brik pastry
ingredients.notes: Available in most Middle Eastern stores or online

instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add a tablespoon of oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place 2 Brik pastries in the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
While the Brik pastry is cooking, mix together hummus, parsley, olives, cucumber, tomato, and red pepper flakes in a bowl.
To assemble, place a cooked Brik pastry on a plate, followed by a spoonful of the hummus mixture.
Fold the Brik pastry in half to enclose the filling.
